summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for post-procedural monitoring following bronchoscopy with balloon dilation of the trachea and bilateral mainstem bronchi due to recurrent tracheal stenosis from Meyhre’s syndrome and relapsing polychondritis. He tolerated the procedure well and was observed for airway stability and pain management. Initial leukocytosis improved without signs of acute infection. Bronchial cultures grew Serratia marcescens and Pseudomonas aeruginosa, interpreted as colonization; thus, systemic antibiotics were avoided and inhaled tobramycin was continued. Chest imaging showed no complications. His pain resolved by hospital day 3, and he was discharged home on scheduled and as-needed pain control, with continuation of all home medications and follow-up arranged with pulmonology and rheumatology.
